name: Auth — signed-in user can reload My Recipes directly

planSteps.description: Enter 'testsprite@herbary.test' in Email and 'Testsprite123!' in Password, then click 'Log In'
Wait until the nav bar shows 'My Recipes'
Load the URL /my-recipes directly in the address bar (full page load, not by clicking a link)
After 3 seconds the URL is still /my-recipes and a heading 'My Recipes' is visible
The nav bar shows a 'Log Out' button
